טבלה: Clalit Nursing Care Claim Serving
This table outlines the process and timelines for handling nursing care claims for Clalit members. It details Harel's obligations regarding claim updates, payment decisions, and compromise proposals.
ממדים: Claim handling stage / condition, Harel's obligation / action

■ In any event of a decision regarding payment of the claim, dispatch of the documents specifed in paragraph D above will not be required, except for a copy of this set of rules.
■ In  any  event  of  a  claim  which  is  adjudicated  in  court,  the  provisions  of  this  paragraph  shall  apply  mutatis  mutandis, according to the circumstances of the matter.
■ In any event where the parties have agreed on payment in the framework of a compromise agreement, Harel shall be exempt from providing a notice under this paragraph as and from that date.
